description.value: The Keg Whistler is a long-established outpost of the Canadian steakhouse chain, occupying one of Whistler Village's historical buildings on the roundabout at Sundial Place. The location offers a patio, bar, lounge, and private and semi-private dining rooms, making it a well-known anchor of the main village dining scene. Takeout and delivery are both available, and free Wi-Fi is offered to guests.
